data.name: Pramod
data.gender_notes: Pramod is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit pra, 'forth', + mud, 'to rejoice' — 'joy, delight'. Its root is Sanskrit pra + mud. A classical Sanskrit term for joy. Pramod is a Sanskrit name meaning “Joy; delight; pleasure”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pramod expresses “Joy; delight; pleasure”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit pra, 'forth', + mud, 'to rejoice' — 'joy, delight'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pramod total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
